mechanism: Omeprazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing clarithromycin metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations; clarithromycin also inhibits CYP3A4, creating bidirectional inhibition.
action: Monitor for clarithromycin toxicity (QT prolongation, arrhythmias, GI effects); consider dose reduction of clarithromycin or alternative antibiotic; obtain baseline ECG if used together.
